My dear [Mrs Mercier](/person/990)
I tried to get your questions answered by sending them to [Miss Bramston](/person/198), the [Dean](/person/197)’s daughter, but unluckily female education at Winchester received a blow when [Mr](/person/85) & [Mrs Awdry](/person/81) went to Hurstpierpoint - and [Mrs Johns](/person/772), the only other lady who really cared, fell ill.

The getting lecturers down needs some energy and there is no one to do it now.
I send you Miss Bramston’s note and that from [Mrs Richards](/person/1902), a lady who is trying to keep a school

yours truly

C M Yonge
